items.name: Bench axe
items.blurb: Pine haft, soft scrap-iron head. Chops trees in the Tangle and on your land.

items.name: Bench pick
items.blurb: Breaks boulders into quarry stone and drift-stone.

items.name: Bench spade
items.blurb: Digs saplings, roots, herbs, turncap spawn and wild honey.

items.name: Stave bucket
items.blurb: Oak staves, iron hoops. Draws water at the well. The hoops loosen with use.

items.name: Tin watering can
items.blurb: Tarrow tin, bought from Silas. Waters a bed in one go. Watering is never required.

items.name: Brack felling axe
items.blurb: Ash haft, iron head forged by Maren Brack, Hollis's sister. Rehafted by Orrin with a trunnel through the eye.

items.name: Nan's lamplighter pole
items.blurb: A long pole with a hook and a wick-trimmer. Sets lamp heads and trims wicks. Carried, it lights the way a little further than a lantern.

items.name: Oak-mark punch
items.blurb: The Hall's wheel-and-wave stamp. Strikes a wax seal into a standing iron-oak. Never wears.

items.name: Carter's lantern
items.blurb: Lights the way in the dark Tangle; wisps keep a little further off. A fill of candle oil lasts a long while.

items.name: Your own whistle
items.blurb: A plain tin whistle from Pip that you dent to your own note. Echoes nearby answer it.

items.name: Forager's satchel
items.blurb: Salt-stained canvas, string ties. Elara's style. Room for a second keepsake.

items.name: Work apron
items.blurb: Leather, with a pencil pocket. Silas's style. Room for a second keepsake.

items.name: Carting coat
items.blurb: Old Compact cut, deep pockets. Room for a second keepsake.

items.name: Timber
items.blurb: Windfall, mostly. Leave three leafy branches at every stump, as the custom runs.

items.name: Stone
items.blurb: Flat quarry stone for footings and hearths. Never drift-stone for a wall.

items.name: Fiber
items.blurb: Bracken and bark-strip, tough enough to weave.

items.name: Amber
items.blurb: Sap the woods have let go of. Amber is the woods' own memory, set hard and glowing.

items.name: Beeswax
items.blurb: Comes with wild honey. For wax seals and waxed cord.

items.name: Tallow
items.blurb: Bought cheaply from Hazel's kitchen. For oils and salves.

items.name: Lamp Wick
items.blurb: Braided fiber, waxed at the tip. A lamp is only as good as its wick.

items.name: Oilcloth Wrap
items.blurb: Fiber cloth rubbed with linseed. Keeps a paper dry on the road.

items.name: Wooden Peg
items.blurb: A peg for a hook or a hinge. The kind of thing you only miss once.

items.name: Fibre rope
items.blurb: Good for the well's rotten rope, and for lashings.

items.name: Loose road-nail
items.blurb: Common at old lamp-stones. Not one of the Eleven. Fitted to a tool, it wears slower.

items.name: Tarrow-steel edge strip
items.blurb: Salvaged from crate-straps at abandoned carts. Fitted to a tool, it bites deeper: fewer swings.

items.name: Amber bead
items.blurb: Polished at the bench from amber. Fitted to a tool, it gives a faint light in the dark.

items.name: Waxed cord
items.blurb: Fiber and beeswax. Wrapped round a haft, the tool is rarely dropped and a little quieter near wisps.

items.name: Warden-stone sliver
items.blurb: Drift-stone that has learned one shape and always walks back to it. A tool carrying one never breaks.

items.name: Comfrey root
items.blurb: Knobbly, two leaves still on it. Planted, it grows into a comfrey bed.

items.name: Keeper's Twists
items.blurb: Hazel's butter batch. A small mend. "Not quite right," she says.

items.name: Finn's oatcakes
items.blurb: A little mend. Sold in fives, of course.

items.name: Saltings tea
items.blurb: Grey-green and salty. Mana comes back slowly over a minute.

items.name: Comfrey salve
items.blurb: Clears the drift's sway at once. "The hands keep more memory than the head."

items.name: Whittled Fox
items.blurb: A carter's door-fox in soft pine, one ear carved longer than the other. Meant for a lintel somewhere.

items.name: Knotted Ox-Halter
items.blurb: Rope worked in a patient, talkative knot, the kind a driver ties while chatting to the oxen.

items.name: Work Glove
items.blurb: Taken off for a fiddly job and never fetched. It still holds the shape of the hand that left it.

items.name: River Glass Bead
items.blurb: Frosted green glass off a carter's harness, tumbled smooth. The Wend brings down what the first frost throws.

items.name: Tin Whistle
items.blurb: Dented to one clear note. Runners dent their whistles until the note is theirs. Whose note this was, nobody says.

items.name: Beeswax Candle
items.blurb: Never lit, saved for a birthday. The Wilds kept it a long while. Now they've handed it back.

items.name: Spare Bootlace
items.blurb: Waxed leather, still knotted in the double hitch runners use, as if the boot came off a moment ago.

items.name: Stamped Road-Nails
items.blurb: Eleven iron nails, each stamped with the wheel and wave. Lantern-post nails. Eleven exactly.

items.name: Ember Charm
items.blurb: A chip of hearth-grade amber in a twist of wire, still warm from the Ashwatch chest. Your strikes find the gaps more often.

items.name: Tool Rack
items.blurb: Pegs for every tool, each one's fittings on show.

items.name: Stone Hearth
items.blurb: Where hearth recipes are made.

items.name: Orrin's mason pick
items.blurb: The pick Orrin dressed the north bridge's footings with. "Drift-stone for foundations, NOT for walls" is cut into the haft.

items.name: Ada's garden spade
items.blurb: Small, polished by eighty years of hands. Ada dug the twins' first garden with it.

items.name: Jar of turncaps
items.blurb: Elara's living compass. The caps tilt toward the nearest named light. Dries out over a few wicks; refresh with fresh turncap spawn.

items.name: Salve satchel
items.blurb: Keeps one remedy always at hand without opening the inventory.

items.name: Seasoned timber
items.blurb: Wanted by fine furniture, beds and tables. "Green wood sinks, dry wood sings."

items.name: Drift-stone
items.blurb: Footings, well linings and post-holes only. Recipes refuse it for walls.

items.name: Iron-oak
items.blurb: From windfall, or a marked, warden-felled standing oak. Heavy, rare, heirloom-grade builds.

items.name: Willow bark
items.blurb: Stripped with the axe from willows by water. Good for tea.

items.name: Storm-grade drop
items.blurb: Very rare amber found deep in the Tangle or the Whitequiet. Kept for storm oil.

items.name: Flour
items.blurb: Bought from Finn: the fine sift, not the grist.

items.name: Wild honey
items.blurb: From hives in hollow trees, gathered with the spade.

items.name: Walnut shells
items.blurb: Swept up along the Wend after the freshet in Mudrise. Hulls for candle boats.

items.name: Madder scraps
items.blurb: From the Carting Day market. Red cloth scraps for festive bunting.

items.name: Amberfall sap
items.blurb: The woods let it go in Amberfall. Window lamps and the Empty Chair's cushion.

items.name: Frost-glass
items.blurb: Off the frozen pond in Quiet. For the Closure Night lamp.

items.name: Bloom flowers
items.blurb: Picked in Bloom. Fresh posies for garlands and pressed-flower frames; they dry over time.

items.name: Dried flowers
items.blurb: Bloom flowers gone brown and papery in the shade. Nothing is lost: dried posies press just as flat.

items.name: Iron-oak wedge
items.blurb: Offcuts at tight-ringed stumps. Fitted to a tool, it wears slower.

items.name: Hoop of tyre-iron
items.blurb: From Maren's wheels at the abandoned cart. Fitted to a tool, nothing splits: wears slower.

items.name: Green-ash haft
items.blurb: Ash trees, now and then, when chopping. Fitted to a tool: lighter, faster, less tiring.

items.name: Split rail
items.blurb: Rough-split timber for closing gaps in fallen fences.

items.name: Slates
items.blurb: Dressed quarry slates for leaking roofs.

items.name: Oak slat
items.blurb: Smooth oak slat for cracked village benches.

items.name: Lamp head
items.blurb: Iron frame, glass and a wick holder for a lantern post. Bought from Orrin or salvaged from old lamp-stones.

items.name: Wax seal
items.blurb: Red-brown wax disc stamped with the wheel and wave. One strike of the oak-mark punch.

items.name: Hazel whip
items.blurb: Thin sapling with round leaves. Planted in lamplight, it grows into a hazel tree.

items.name: Birch sapling
items.blurb: White-barked sapling. Planted in lamplight, it grows into a birch tree.

items.name: Rowan sapling
items.blurb: Sapling with red clusters in Amberfall. Planted in lamplight, it grows into a rowan tree.

items.name: Wild thyme
items.blurb: Tiny-leaved sprig. Planted in lamplight, it grows into a thyme bed for tea.

items.name: Turncap spawn
items.blurb: Pale cap on a sliver of wood. Sprouts on a stump at home and leans toward your lantern post.

items.name: Iron-oak acorn
items.blurb: Very rare. Grows only in lamplight, over weeks of real time, into a tight-ringed iron-oak.

items.name: Keeper's Twists (oil)
items.blurb: Hazel's oil batch. Darker, with a burnt end. HP and a little mana.

items.name: Willow-bark tea
items.blurb: Eases the drift's sway slowly. Willow bark and fresh well water.

items.name: A pinch of Blue Moss
items.blurb: Nearby wisps forget you for a short while, so you can slip past a camp.

items.name: Candle oil
items.blurb: Refills a carried lantern. Small corked vial of pale amber oil.

items.name: Hearth oil
items.blurb: Lights lantern posts and window lamps once each; a gift for Ada's window.

items.name: Storm oil
items.blurb: Rare. Kept for the old ways. Stoppered flask with a bright core.

items.name: A mirror-wise fox
items.blurb: Silas carves them with the long ear on the left; collect them and compare the ears.

items.name: Lantern Post
items.blurb: Expands your land. Holds back the dark where its light falls.

items.name: Gate shelf
items.blurb: Pure-gift shelf for passers-by on the Commons lane.

items.name: Writing desk
items.blurb: A slant-top desk for copying recipe pages to give away.

items.name: Keepsake cabinet
items.blurb: Glass-front case to display keepsakes for visitors.

items.name: Herb drying rack
items.blurb: Holds herbs from your beds and shows them hanging.

items.name: Apothecary shelf
items.blurb: Jars fill to show your stock of remedies.

items.name: Woodpile
items.blurb: Green timber stacked here seasons after a real day. "Green wood sinks, dry wood sings."

items.name: Raised bed
items.blurb: Timber-edged bed of dark soil to plant herbs and saplings.

items.name: Window lamp
items.blurb: Hearth-grade. Your window shows lit from the Commons lane; at Amberwake every lit window adds to the village's glow.

items.name: Naming-slip frame
items.blurb: Frames your first lantern post naming slip.

items.name: Pip's pencil map
items.blurb: A copy from Pip, in pencil because the lines drift. Smudges a little each season.

items.name: Pressed-flower frame
items.blurb: Framed posy from Bloom flowers, fresh or dried.

items.name: Candle hulls
items.blurb: A shelf of walnut-shell boats; float one on the pond for the Breaking.

items.name: Carting bunting
items.blurb: Red and cream bunting strung across your gate for Carting Day.

items.name: The Empty Chair
items.blurb: Set at your table for those lost in the Tangle.

items.name: Closure Night lamp
items.blurb: Frost-glass lamp facing the dark for Closure Night.

items.name: Door-fox
items.blurb: Silas carves it when you get your deed, mirror-wise. Can't be sold or given.

items.name: Recipe page: Saltings tea
items.blurb: A rag paper slip with a cup sketch, from Elara. Wild thyme and well water.

items.name: Recipe page: Comfrey salve
items.blurb: An aged leaf of Mother Cotta's book with a botanical comfrey sketch, via Mara. Comfrey root and tallow.

items.name: Recipe page: Candle oil
items.blurb: A neat library slip with oil flask notation, from Mara. Amber and tallow.

items.name: Recipe page: Willow-bark tea
items.blurb: A book leaf of Mother Cotta's herbal with a curl-of-bark sketch. Willow bark and well water.

items.name: Recipe card: Keeper's Twists
items.blurb: A flour-dusted bakery card from Hazel's wall. Flour and wild honey.

items.name: Recipe card: Oil twists
items.blurb: A darker stained bakery card from Hazel with a note on the back. Flour, wild honey, and candle oil.

items.name: Recipe page: Hearth oil
items.blurb: A ruled ledger receipt leaf from Ada Cooley's window fund. Amber and tallow.

items.name: Recipe page: Wax seal
items.blurb: A printed page from a Brackenwood handbook with the wheel-and-wave stamp. Beeswax.

items.name: Recipe page: Storm oil
items.blurb: A torn margin from Wenna's ledger in dense dark script. Storm-grade drop and tallow.

items.name: Well water
items.blurb: Fresh water drawn from the well with a stave bucket.

items.name: Willow rod
items.blurb: A plain willow rod with a cork grip and a wound line. One use per kept fish.

items.name: Mill roach
items.blurb: Silver with red fins. Comes up to the wheel for the meal dust.

items.name: Miller's fry
items.blurb: Two small floured fish in a pan, a sprig on top. Flour, a hot pan, and don't fuss it.

items.name: Recipe card: Miller's fry
items.blurb: A flour-dusted bakery card from Hazel, checked against a roach she kept. One mill roach and a scoop of flour.

pickups.label: Pick up the coil of rope
pickups.found: A coil of rope, left by the well. Someone meant to mend it.

pickups.label: Pick up the lost glove
pickups.found: A work glove on the lane, still holding the shape of a hand.

pickups.label: Pick up the dropped bucket
pickups.found: A stave bucket in the bracken, hoops a little loose. The woods give things back.

pickups.label: Pick up the paper parcel
pickups.found: Five of Finn's oatcakes, wrapped in paper. Five, of course.

goods.label: Buy a lump of tallow · 1 ember
goods.line: Tallow's an ember a lump and worth two, the pot renders sweet. Mind your sleeves, it spits.

goods.label: Buy a sack of flour · 1 ember
goods.line: The fine sift, not the grist — I milled it while the wheel held. Forty-one and holding, this morning.

goods.label: Buy a willow rod · 2 embers
goods.line: Another off the hook by the door — two embers, and it only wears on the fish you keep.

goods.label: Buy madder scraps · 1 ember
goods.line: Red scraps off the dyer's boards. An ember a handful — no haggling, it's fair day.
